title: EnrichedProductMessage
description: Creative Force inbound payload for the Enriched Product ingestion pipeline. Aligned to the Enriched Product – Data Model Mapping document.

productId.description: Unique product identifier. Maps to _id, variantId, and Mongo productId. Mapping rows #1, #20, #21.

uvStyleCode.description: Optional Creative Force style code. Not mapped to Mongo productId (productId uses inbound productId).

brand.description: Brand / banner — preferred source for banner field. Mapping row #22.

shortDescription.description: Short marketing description. Maps to productName. Mandatory. Mapping row #5.

longDescription.description: Full marketing description. Maps to productDescription. Mandatory. Mapping row #6.

materialBreakdown.description: Primary material. Maps to fabric. Mapping row #9.

styleForBullet.description: Comma-separated style bullets stored as a string. Mapping row #10.

pattern.description: Visual pattern. Maps to pattern. Mapping row #11.

btFit.description: Big & tall / fit copy. Maps to Mongo btFit. Optional.

onlineExclusive.description: Online-exclusive flag as Y/N string. Transformed to Boolean. Mapping row #12.

defaultColor.description: Default-colour flag as Y/N string. Transformed to Boolean. Mapping row #13.

assetNames.description: Comma-separated asset filenames. Split into mainImage, altImage[], video. Mapping rows #16, #17, #18.

additionalAssociation.description: Cross-sell associations. null coerced to []. Mapping row #19.
